verdict.rationale: Parahelp's security page documents a first-party retention control: workspace admins can disable all personal data storage so Parahelp does not retain it. This is an all-or-nothing switch. Nothing in the pack covers configurable retention periods, deleting stored data, or independent corroboration. missing for 10: configurable retention windows, documented deletion/erasure workflow or API, granular per-data-type controls, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Workspace admins can disable all personal data storage in the platform if they do not want Parahelp to retain this data.
